verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no published directory or discovery index that an agent can query to find payable services or APIs. Store Sync makes a merchant's physical-goods catalog discoverable to partner AI shopping assistants. That is merchant-side catalog syndication, an adjacent capability, not a queryable registry of payable services. The llms.txt file and the MCP OAuth metadata only describe PayPal's own docs and auth, not a directory of services.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my agent can discover payable services and APIs through a published directory or discovery index
